pr_title: Refactor and remove excessive calls of `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED`
pr_body:

Fixes (partially, see https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/62846) https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/50743
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/62844
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/61765

See the updated `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` documentation for when it should be called.

After this is merged, https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/62846 can be merged, and https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/50743 can be closed.
pr_comments: Okay, originally the plan was to wait to set `theme_owner`'s until when the control/window enters the tree, and set it to `nullptr` when the control/window leaves the scene tree, but the problem is there is a lot of code in the editor that doesn't fetch it's theme data in `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` like it should, and so for now `theme_owner` will still get assigned outside of the scene tree and everything works as before.
Can you please rebase this now that https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/63318 is merged?
Remembered I should update the documentation as well

Rebased after https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/63595, and a few small improvements made. I'm thinking this is good enough for now, more refactoring and improvements can be done in future PRs.

Marking as draft again, hopefully for the last time :)
I made some changes last night that I want to test a little more thoroughly and document a little better.
Also needs a rebase, then should be good to go

issue_context.title: Changes to `Window`'s theme don't propagate
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

Godot 4 alpha 9

### System information

Win11

### Issue description

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50304111/172254360-1b9bceb3-bf3c-4d8d-a184-d4dd54d052ba.mp4

I'm currently working on a fix

### Steps to reproduce

See above

### Minimal reproduction project


[MRP.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/8848299/MRP.zip)
comments:
The same thing is true of the custom theme defined in the project settings.

Edit: opened [a separate issue for this](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/62844).

review_comments:
The `update_minimum_size()` is redundant as it's already called in `case NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED`:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ba2aa30a1861aed55d1fc80fe48bc356afdf17bd/scene/gui/control.cpp#L3147
I'm a bit concerned that this code is executed not just when entering the tree, but also when the node is set as top level. But that doesn't seem to have any effect on the theme, so should be fine.

> I'll try and get this fixed today

Well that was a long day 🙃, thanks for your patience

So the problem was from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/64271. Adding an error message to the log requires access to its theme items (e.g. error icon). https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/060d0ce88204f9180beb3764048975e9dcf5c496/modules/gltf/register_types.cpp#L99 is getting called before the EditorLog has entered the SceneTree. This means `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED` won't have been called yet, and the EditorLog's theme cache won't have been initialized, hence the crash. Fortunately, the log is already rebuilt anyway  on `NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGE`, so I added this check to simply `return` early if the EditorLog hasn't entered the scene yet. Theoretically this should be more performant anyway since it won't have to add the log line twice.
Here "this" seems to be "p_child", `Control::_propagate_theme_changed` may switch `p_assign` if the same node is set multiple times, so propagation may be interrupted.

@Rindbee I think you're totally right, I missed that. I think I was using `this` because originally this code actually was using `NOTIFICATION_PARENTED`, but I realized I'd have to change less code and I thought it'd have the same effect if I just used `add_child_notify` instead, since the only time theme items need to be propagated from a parent node is when that parent node is a control/window.
I fixed this `this` issue in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/65250 btw.

> so propagation may be interrupted

I think you're thinking if the node `add_child_notify` is called on has `theme` set, then it might not be assigned as the theme owner to children without `theme` set, but that's not the case since there's a `c != p_owner` check before setting `assign = false` in `add_child_notify`, which is there for when `set_theme` is called with a non-null theme.
I'd add a comment that theme propagation breaks at non-Control/non-Window nodes. Just a bit of explicitness for the ones who follow us.
Same as here.

The `update_minimum_size()` is redundant as it's already called in `case NOTIFICATION_THEME_CHANGED`:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ba2aa30a1861aed55d1fc80fe48bc356afdf17bd/scene/gui/control.cpp#L3147
Same as here.
This seems to ignore the case where the window has no parent (the root window).

What do you mean? If the window has no parent then `parent_c` and `parent_w` will both be `nullptr`, and `Control::_propagate_theme_changed(this, nullptr, nullptr, is_inside_tree(), true);` will be called. How is that case any different than when the window has a parent that isn't a control or window?
I'm sorry, you're right, apologies for the reckless remarks earlier.
